entities.name: Fethiye Mosque, Athens
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Fethiye Mosque is a former mosque in central Athens, Greece. Completed in the 17th-century during the Ottoman-era, the mosque was repurposed after Greek independence in 1834, it fell into disrepair, but after renovations it was reopened to the public in 2017 for cultural purposes.
